long.title: My favourite place to relax
long.text:
A  Lena
There is a small lake near my town, and I go there on Sunday mornings when it is quiet. I usually take a book and sit under a big tree. Sometimes my brother comes with me and we go fishing, but we never catch much! In winter it is too cold, so I go to the library instead. The best thing about the lake is that it is free.
B  Tom
My favourite place is my grandmother's garden. She grows vegetables and lots of flowers, and I help her every Saturday. We often cook lunch together with the vegetables we pick. It takes me forty minutes to get there by bus, but I don't mind because I listen to music on the way. My friends think gardening is boring, but I find it relaxing.
C  Mai
I relax at the swimming pool in the city centre. I go three times a week, usually in the evening after work. It costs five pounds each time, which is quite expensive, so I want to buy a monthly ticket. After swimming I always feel tired but happy. I sometimes meet my friend Kim there and we have a coffee in the café.

pm.q: Who travels to their favourite place by bus?
pm.why: Tom: It takes me forty minutes to get there by bus.

pm.q: Who has to pay to use their favourite place?
pm.why: Mai: It costs five pounds each time.

pm.q: Who does something different when the weather is cold?
pm.why: Lena: In winter it is too cold, so I go to the library instead.

pm.q: Who sometimes meets a friend there?
pm.why: Mai: I sometimes meet my friend Kim there.

pm.q: Who prepares food at their favourite place?
pm.why: Tom: We often cook lunch together.

pm.q: Who says that other people don't understand why they enjoy it?
pm.why: Tom: My friends think gardening is boring.

pm.q: Who likes going there when there are not many people?
pm.why: Lena: I go there on Sunday mornings when it is quiet.

long.title: Learning a new sport
long.text:
A  Ben
Last year I started playing tennis at a club near my school. My teacher there is very patient and explains everything clearly. I have lessons twice a week, on Tuesdays and Thursdays. At first I couldn't hit the ball over the net, but now I can play quite well. I'd like to enter a competition next summer. The only problem is that my racket is old, so I need to buy a new one.
B  Sara
I learned to ski on a school trip to Italy in February. It was my first time in the mountains, and I was very nervous on the first day. I fell over many times! But by the end of the week I could ski down the easy slopes without help. I want to go back next winter with my family, but skiing holidays are very expensive.
C  Huy
I joined a basketball team at the sports centre three months ago. I'm the tallest person in my class, so my friends said I should try it. We train every Saturday morning for two hours. The other players are older than me, but they are very friendly. Last month we won our first match, and I scored six points. I'm hoping to play for the city team one day.

pm.q: Who learned their sport during a trip to another country?
pm.why: Sara: on a school trip to Italy.

pm.q: Who needs some new equipment?
pm.why: Ben: my racket is old, so I need to buy a new one.

pm.q: Who started their sport because other people suggested it?
pm.why: Huy: my friends said I should try it.

pm.q: Who has already won a game?
pm.why: Huy: Last month we won our first match.

pm.q: Who practises on two different days each week?
pm.why: Ben: twice a week, on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

pm.q: Who felt worried at the beginning?
pm.why: Sara: I was very nervous on the first day.

pm.q: Who thinks that the cost could be a problem?
pm.why: Sara: skiing holidays are very expensive.

long.title: My first job
long.text:
A  Nick
My first job was in a bookshop when I was seventeen. I worked there every Saturday for a year. I put new books on the shelves and helped customers find what they wanted. The manager was quite strict, but I learned a lot from her. The pay wasn't very good, but I could buy books cheaply, which I loved because I read a lot.
B  Anna
When I was sixteen, I got a summer job at a hotel by the sea. I cleaned rooms in the morning and worked in the restaurant in the evening. It was hard work and I was always tired, but I made some great friends. We often went to the beach together after work. I also practised my English because many of the guests came from other countries.
C  Long
My first job was delivering newspapers in my neighbourhood. I had to get up at five o'clock every morning before school, even in winter when it was dark and cold. I used my bike, so I got very fit! I did the job for two years and saved enough money to buy my first computer. My parents were surprised that I never missed a day.

pm.q: Who used a foreign language at work?
pm.why: Anna: I also practised my English… guests came from other countries.

pm.q: Who had to start work very early in the day?
pm.why: Long: get up at five o'clock every morning.

pm.q: Who could buy things more cheaply because of their job?
pm.why: Nick: I could buy books cheaply.

pm.q: Who worked for someone who was quite strict?
pm.why: Nick: The manager was quite strict.

pm.q: Who bought something expensive with the money they earned?
pm.why: Long: saved enough money to buy my first computer.

pm.q: Who did two different kinds of work on the same day?
pm.why: Anna: cleaned rooms in the morning and worked in the restaurant in the evening.

pm.q: Who got exercise while they were working?
pm.why: Long: I used my bike, so I got very fit.

mc.title: Bikes for everyone
mc.text: In our town, you can now {1} a bike from one of twenty bike stations. You pay with a card, and the first thirty minutes are {2}. After that, it costs one pound an hour. The bikes are very popular with students, who use them to {3} to college. Some people were {4} that the bikes would be stolen, but this has not happened. Next year the town plans to open ten more stations and to {5} electric bikes for people who live on the hills. For more information, you can {6} the town council's website.

gaps.why: rent a bike = thuê xe; lend = cho mượn (người khác).
the first thirty minutes are free = 30 phút đầu miễn phí (sau đó mới tính tiền).
travel to college = đi tới trường; arrive cần at / in; không drive xe đạp.
worried that… = lo rằng…
offer electric bikes = cung cấp xe đạp điện.
visit a website; go cần to, look cần at.

mc.title: My grandmother's garden
mc.text: My grandmother has a small garden behind her house. She {1} most of her free time there, even in winter. She grows vegetables such as carrots and beans, and she {2} gives some to her neighbours. Last year she {3} a prize at the town flower show for her roses. She was so {4} that she put the photo on her kitchen wall. When I visit her, she always {5} me to help with the watering. I don't mind, because she {6} me a cake afterwards!

gaps.why: spend time = dành thời gian.
often = thường; ever / yet không đứng ở câu khẳng định như vậy.
win a prize = đoạt giải.
so proud that… = tự hào tới mức…
ask sb to do = nhờ ai làm; say / speak không đi với me to.
make sb a cake = làm bánh cho ai.

open.title: An email to a friend
open.text:
Hi Sam,
Thanks {1} your email. I'm sorry I didn't reply sooner, but I {2} very busy last week. We had exams at school, and I studied every evening. Now the exams are finished, {3} I can relax! Are you free on Saturday? There's a new café {4} the park, and I'd like to try it. We could meet there at eleven o'clock and then go for a walk. My brother is coming too, {5} he wants to meet you. Let me know {6} you can come.
See you soon,
Alex

gaps.why: Thanks for…
last week → quá khứ: I was busy.
…, so I can relax = nên tôi được nghỉ.
giới từ chỉ nơi chốn: in / near the park.
because + lý do.
Let me know if… = báo tôi biết liệu…

open.title: My first day at work
open.text: Last Monday was my first day {1} a waiter at a busy restaurant in the city centre. I arrived early because I didn't want to {2} late. The manager showed me {3} to carry three plates at the same time. It was difficult, and I dropped one! Everyone laughed, but they were very kind to me. {4} the afternoon, I served more than fifty customers. I was tired when I got home, but I was happy {5} I had learned so much. I'm looking forward {6} going back tomorrow.

gaps.why: work as a waiter = làm bồi bàn.
want to be late.
show sb how to do = chỉ cách làm.
in / during the afternoon.
happy because… = vui vì…
look forward to + V-ing.
